items.summary: Disposition: blocked for public beta/full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights and jurisdictional privacy decisions. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial/public redistribution, storage, derivatives, display, caching, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; Woot terms restrict collection and commercial use. SearchWoot legal tracking is active with 0 of 4 tasks closed. Data-use reviews: Woot deal/price data = blocked; user alert rules/sync results = evidence_needed; GA4 = evidence_needed; operational logs/Cloudflare data = evidence_needed. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, with 20 banner/consent/GA4 findings and 4 privacy/terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain blocked. Exact decision: retain keep_private, do not send rights outreach, do not approve go-live, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work and ordinary reversible growth that adds no new collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, or cross-site behavior. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering the repository/config data-flow table, retention/deletion/correction/access controls, deployed consent behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing/retention settings, log-field inventory, vendor terms/DPA status, and incident/request procedures.
